violation_type.title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)
violation_type.typical_finding: Sink in the Toddler classroom is not working as the water does not come out when faucet is turned to "on".

finding_variants.text: Sink in the Toddler classroom is not working as the water does not come out when faucet is turned to "on".
Based on the DFPS investigation, soap and water were not available to wash hands after diaper changing.

During the walk through of a classroom it was it was found the children did not have soap for hand washing and caregiver stated they had not had soap all morning and was using hand sanitizer to wash the children's hands.
The bathroom in the toddler/young pre-k room did not have paper towels or soap.     This was corrected at inspection when soap and paper towels were supplied.
One of the restrooms in the hallway is missing paper towels.
Hand soap and paper towels were not independently accessible to children at the Preschool hand sinks. This was corrected at inspection when a soap dispenser was provided and hand towels were stocked.

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Two of the restroom sinks were not equipped with soap and paper towels. One classroom sink was equipped with soap but not paper towels.
Location of Handwashing Sink: There were no single-use towels for handwashing available. Five children and a caregiver were observed washing their hands and not drying them.

Location of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection two sinks inside of the classrooms were observed without soap.     This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver filled the soap dispensers located by the sinks in the classrooms.

Location of Handwashing Sink: The front restroom off the prek room did not have paper towels accessible to the children.  The paper towel holder needed new batteries and the roll of available towels sat out of the reach of the children on top of a 3/4 wall.    NOTE:  A battery was replaced in the paper towel dispenser during the inspection.

Location of Handwashing Sink: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to conclude that the infant classrooms sink was broken and not equipped with running water.

Location of Handwashing Sink: Hand soap and paper towels were not independently accessible to children at the Preschool hand sinks. This was corrected at inspection when a soap dispenser was provided and hand towels were stocked.

Location of Handwashing Sink: The two restrooms being utilized by children in care were not equipped with hand soap or disposable paper towels. This was corrected by hand soap and paper towels being placed in the restrooms for the children's use.

Location of Handwashing Sink: It was observed that three different sets of double sink handles were missing from the faucets.
Location of Handwashing Sink: Multiple classrooms at the operation have been using one cloth to clean children's hands throughout the day and not individual cloths or disposable paper towels.
Location of Handwashing Sink: The Preschool 2 classroom contained a sink without running water.

Location of Handwashing Sink: There were no papertowels for children to dry their hands after handwashing. Children requested from teacher papertowels and they were later supplied after handwashing was completed and CCR addressed lack of.

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Hand washing sink did not include soap.  Soap was added during the inspection.
Location of Handwashing Sink: Soap was not available to children in the 2 year old room.    NOTE: Soap was provided during the inspeciton.
Location of Handwashing Sink: Two classrooms did not have paper towels in the hand washing sink area.     Corrected at Inspection: Paper towels were placed in the area.

Location of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection it was observed that two of the hand washing sinks were not equipped with soap, two of the hand washing sinks were not equipped with paper towels and two of the toilets were not equipped with toilet paper.

Location of Handwashing Sink: The handwashing sink area near the boy's restroom did not have any paper towels. This was corrected at inspection when the director put paper towels in the dispenser. A photo was taken.
Location of Handwashing Sink: There was no handwashing sink or diaper changing area in an area that will be used by children in diapers.
Location of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection it was observed that there was no paper towels in the bathroom for the school age children.

Location of Handwashing Sink: During the walk-through in classroom Pepper, no disposable towels were available near the hand-washing sink. Note: caregivers added disposable towels near the hand-washing sink.
Location of Handwashing Sink: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that the bathroom in the pre k classroom was not equipped with soap for hand washing.

Location of Handwashing Sink: The hand washing sinks in the Pre-Kindergarten and School Age classrooms were not equipped with paper towels or soap.    Note: The provider added refilled the soap and paper towels during the inspection.
Location of Handwashing Sink: The hand washing sink in a classroom did not have soap and paper towels.  Corrected at Inspection: Soap and paper towels were placed during the inspection.

Location of Handwashing Sink: Two classrooms did not have paper towels and soap in the hand washing sink area.     Corrected at Inspection: The soap and paper towels were placed during the inspection.
Location of Handwashing Sink: One sink in the three years bathroom did not have running water.     The other sink had a faulty spout and when turned on would cause water to drip onto the floor.

Location of Handwashing Sink: During the walk-through it was observed in Room #3 no single-use disposable towels available for the children after hand washing.     Note-Corrected during Inspection. Operation added disposable towels to Classroom # 3.
Location of Handwashing Sink: During the walk-through it was observed #11, and #7 classrooms did not have hand soap available for children.     Note: Soap was added during the inspection.

Location of Handwashing Sink: 2 outside bathrooms that are used by children did not have paper towels available for children to use after handwashing. This was corrected when paper towels were added to the bathrooms.

Location of Handwashing Sink: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that two of the sinks available for children's use did not have soap available for use.   This was corrected at inspeciton when soap was added.
Location of Handwashing Sink: Several bathrooms that are used by children did not have paper towels or toilet paper.
Location of Handwashing Sink: The bathroom in the toddler/young pre-k room did not have paper towels or soap.     This was corrected at inspection when soap and paper towels were supplied.
Location of Handwashing Sink: The restroom in the schoolers classroom did not have soap or paper towels available. This was corrected at inspection.
Location of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection a bathroom ulitized by children in care did not have soap and paper towels.

Location of Handwashing Sink: During the walk through of a classroom it was it was found the children did not have soap for hand washing and caregiver stated they had not had soap all morning and was using hand sanitizer to wash the children's hands.

Location of Handwashing Sink: Two classrooms did not have step stools to allow for safe access for children to the adult height sinks in each restroom.   This was corrected at inspection when step stools were placed in each restroom. Photos of the restrooms without and with the step stools were taken.
Location of Handwashing Sink: There was no soap or paper towels available in the boy's and girl's toddler restrooms.     This was corrected at inspection when the soap and paper towels were stocked.
